``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # ============================================================ # 7. FILTROS # ============================================================ filtro_departamento <- filter_select( id = "filtro_departamento", label = "Departamento", sharedData = shared_datos, group = ~departamento, multiple = TRUE ) filtro_experiencia <- filter_select( id = "filtro_experiencia", label = "Experiencia", sharedData = shared_datos, group = ~experiencia, multiple = TRUE ) filtro_formacion <- filter_select( id = "filtro_formacion", label = "Formación", sharedData = shared_datos, group = ~formacion, multiple = TRUE ) filtro_ingreso <- filter_select( id = "filtro_ingreso", label = "Ingreso", sharedData = shared_datos, group = ~ingreso, multiple = TRUE ) filtro_area <- filter_select( id = "filtro_area", label = "Área de trabajo", sharedData = shared_datos, group = ~area_trabajo, multiple = TRUE ) filtro_activo <- filter_select( id = "filtro_activo", label = "Situación laboral", sharedData = shared_datos, group = ~activo, multiple = TRUE ) # ============================================================ # 8. CONTENEDOR DE FILTROS # ============================================================ div( class = "dashboard-filters", div( class = "dashboard-filter", tags$strong("Departamento"), filtro_departamento ), div( class = "dashboard-filter", tags$strong("Experiencia"), filtro_experiencia ), div( class = "dashboard-filter", tags$strong("Formación"), filtro_formacion ), div( class = "dashboard-filter", tags$strong("Ingresos"), filtro_ingreso ), div( class = "dashboard-filter", tags$strong("Área de trabajo"), filtro_area ), div( class = "dashboard-filter", tags$strong("Situación laboral"), filtro_activo ) ) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
